keyboard_type.description: Type of keyboard interface; common values: 'usb', 'at', 'ps2', 'serial', 'bluetooth'.

num_braille_dots.description: Number of braille dots per cell (typically 6 or 8).

encoding.description: Character encoding used for braille output. Choose 'braille' (Braille ASCII), 'utf-8', or 'ascii'.

braille_dot_mappings.description: List of key-to-dot-pattern mappings. Each entry maps a physical key (e.g., 'a', 'F1') to a set of braille dots (1–6, sometimes 7–8).

dots.description: List of braille dot numbers (1–6) activated by this key.

command_mappings.description: List of key-to-braille-command mappings (e.g., cursor up/down, window navigation, screen read).

character_mappings.description: List of key-to-character mappings for direct alphanumeric/symbol output.

modifier_definitions.description: Optional list of modifier key definitions (e.g., Shift, Ctrl, Alt) used in combination mappings.

keys.description: Physical key identifiers that act as this modifier.

key_repeat_delay.description: Delay (ms) before key repeat begins. Set to 0 to disable repeat.

key_repeat_rate.description: Rate (ms) of key repeat once started (lower = faster repeat).

auto_learn.description: Enable or disable 'auto-learn' mode, where key presses are automatically added to the mapping table.
